mechanism_narrative: A supply-side expansion, indicated by the industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeding 100 (base year 2017), is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails if the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates a tightening labor market, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased consumer spending and corporate profits.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails if the S&P 500 has negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A dovish monetary policy response, characterized by a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) of more than 0.5 percentage points over the past three months coupled with elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 310), typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates sustained economic growth.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decrease > 0.5pp in 3 months and CPIAUCSL > 310
failure_condition: The mechanism fails if the S&P 500 has negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation and high-interest-rate regime (CPIAUCSL > 310 and FEDFUNDS > 5.0), the S&P 500 typically experiences negative 20-day returns due to the contractionary impact of monetary policy on economic activity.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails if the S&P 500 has positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market expansion, indicated by housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1000 thousand units, is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to increased consumer confidence and construction activity.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails if the S&P 500 has negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1000.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market, indicated by payroll employment growth exceeding 0.5% over the past three months, typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer spending increases.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails if the S&P 500 has negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods with PAYEMS growth > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A synchronized expansion in both industrial production (INDPRO > 100) and retail sales (RSAFS growth > 0.3% in 3 months) indicates robust economic activity, which typically results in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 100 and RSAFS growth > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: The mechanism fails if the S&P 500 has negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation, indicated by CPIAUCSL exceeding 310, typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the Federal Reserve may respond with interest rate increases.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails if the S&P 500 has positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 310.
